name: @tzyc/dsh-model-visibility
description: Choose which models appear in the chat composer's model list, with per-provider groups, per-model capability tags sourced from the adapter, the relay model list, a learned local snapshot seeded by an online verification run (public catalogs plus a user-chosen checker model, with optional write-back into provider settings), vendor corrections and manual overrides, separate coloured labels for image/video generation models, name search and capability filters, collapsible provider groups, a hard capability re-fetch, a token-usage strip (today / week / month / total) with one-click CSV exports, per-model overrides that can also be written back into the model provider's own settings, and an image-input alignment (on by default) for relay routes.
author: TZYCeng
